'''Treston Lines, Ltd.''' was a large company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The company was known as a major cargo transport company, and the heads of the company were given positions in the city's ruling class, the [[Exex]]. They were one of the companies, alongside [[Bioniip Laboratories/Legends|Bioniip Laboratories]] and [[Vew-Grek Holo Images]], that called for Cloud City to declare its allegiance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GG2" />
